rung.description: Interdiction ladder rung (docs/25). L0 observe, L1 challenge, L2 rate-limit, L3 egress-allowlist, L4 domain block, L5 IP deny, L6 host quarantine, L7 routing, NONE for no action.

segment_id.description: Present when the decision applies to an allow-first segment (docs/26).

ttl_seconds.description: Actual TTL after any randomized jitter (docs/29).

nominal_ttl_seconds.description: Policy-nominal TTL before jitter; present when randomization applied.

randomization.description: Recorded draw(s) enabling exact replay (docs/29); null when no randomized mechanism applied. A single draw is an object (legacy shape); a decision carrying multiple mechanisms (e.g. rate_ceiling + ttl_jitter) carries an array of draw objects — v2.2 aligns the schema with that shape.

attribution_refs.description: Display-only attribution references (docs/30). NEVER a decision input: the engine never populates this field, and decisions are byte-identical with and without any attribution records. Present (empty) in engine output for explicit display-only typing.

content_hash.description: Action-instance identity (docs/25, docs/29, docs/30): a SHA-256 content hash over the FULL parameterized output (disposition, action, rung, selector, ttl_seconds, randomization draw, policy_version). Distinct from `id` (the LOGICAL decision, persistent across epochs). Receipts/reconciliation/revocation reference the exact action INSTANCE via this hash. Empty string for non-actionable decisions that emit no enforcement artifact.

epoch.description: Randomization epoch the draw was taken in (docs/29); part of the reproducible seed material.

actionSelector.description: Typed enforcement selector (docs/25). Context-acting actions MUST carry client/protocol context; rate_limit MUST carry a ceiling.

rate_ceiling_per_min.description: Requests/minute permitted (docs/25). Mandatory on rate_limit actions; drawn within docs/29 rate_ceiling bounds with the draw recorded.
